findings.failing_input: fmtMoney does Math.round(n) before passing to MONEY formatter. MONEY is configured with maximumFractionDigits=0, so a non-rounded value would still display as integer. The Math.round is redundant but not buggy.

STORE_HUES has 3 hardcoded stores (uzoshop, Zol Plus, 360usmile). New stores fall back to the 5-color cycle. This is the same drift risk as postgresReaders STORE_NAME_BY_ID (STA-07) — operator's mental model is 'each store has its color', so a 4th store would mismatch chart vs sparkline vs chip.
findings.expected: Centralize store metadata (name + color) in one config; derive from stores table on first load.
findings.actual: Hardcoded; 4 hardcoded locations across the codebase.
findings.fix_sketch: Already noted in audit Phase 9 cross-surface point #5 — extract per-store config to a shared module.

uncertainty_notes: RTL-safe formatting via <bdi dir='ltr'> + typographic minus U+2212 is correctly implemented. Formatters are module-level singletons (fast). The pattern handles all the operator-visible numeric atoms (count, money, %, delta%, 2-decimal). MONEY_2 vs NUM_2 vs PCT_FORMATTER vs SIGN_FORMATTER ensures consistent decimal handling per axis. No correctness issues with current 3-store fleet.
